articles.title: First U.S. spot bitcoin ETF to close as inflows dwindle, investors chase AI returns
articles.snippet: Hashdex's DEFI, the smallest of the funds, held $14.7 million under management, compared with $47.08 billion for BlackRock’s IBIT.

articles.title: Hashdex to shut smallest Bitcoin ETF after more than two years
articles.snippet: The spot price Bitcoin exchange-traded fund, which was never able to attract more than $18 million in net assets, will pay out investors and sell its 225 BTC in the coming weeks.

articles.title: Hashdex to Shut Down Bitcoin ETF After Struggling to Gain Assets
articles.snippet: The Brazil-based crypto asset manager will liquidate its U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF later this month, ending a fund that entered the market in 2024.

articles.title: Solo Bitcoin Miner Hits Jackpot, Scoring $200K BTC Reward
articles.snippet: CKPool's developer put the winner's hashrate at a “wildly variable” peak of 100 PH, noting that it was probably rented.
